annotations.title: Benefit galas: the dates, the dress code, and who the money goes to

description: The East End's 2026 benefit season: 15 dated charity galas, each joined to the nonprofit it raises for. `dressCode` is the organiser's own: it is 'Cocktail' on 9 of the 15 and 'Black Tie' on 1; the codes on file are Black Tie, Casual, Cocktail, Garden Casual, Hamptons Chic, Rodeo Glam. `tickets.publishedRate` is per record: false on 14 of the 15, a verified finding that the organiser hands off to a ticketing platform and prints no rate; true on 1, where `tickets.published` carries the organiser's own figure with the URL an editor read it from and the date, as the entry rate ('from') of a ladder. `tickets.tier` is a relative band across these events, not a figure. `tickets.publishedTiers`, where present, is a published line an editor read, including lines that say no price is published and give a phone number. `beneficiary` carries the charity's mission, phone, `donateUrl` and `volunteerUrl`, verified more recently than the ticket link. `alsoThisSeason` holds marquee fixtures with no dated gala record (the Hampton Classic, Authors Night, the art fair). Past benefits appear only when `from` is an earlier date. Returns up to 10. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

cause.description: Filter to one cause, when the question is plainly about one.

from.description: ISO date. Default is today (East End local), so only benefits still to come are returned. Pass an earlier date to reach ones already held.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'animal', 'ARF', 'black tie', 'film', 'land trust', or a benefit's name.

to.description: ISO date. Omit for the rest of the season.

town.description: A hamlet ('East Hampton', 'Sag Harbor') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'North Fork'), in the asker's own words.
